result.summary: All three vendors — Cisco Meraki, Juniper Mist, and Aruba Central — offer cloud-native, subscription-based Wi-Fi 6E solutions broadly comparable in per-AP annual cost (roughly $125–$160/AP/year at estimated list prices, varying by tier and volume). Juniper Mist is broadly recognized for the depth of its AI/assurance capabilities via Marvis, making it a strong fit for institutions that prioritize proactive, AI-driven network operations; however, it may require higher subscription tiers to unlock those features. Cisco Meraki offers the most mature and widely deployed cloud dashboard with a straightforward management experience, though its AI tooling is generally considered less advanced and its strictly subscription-only model leaves no perpetual exit path. Aruba Central provides strong multi-domain management (Wi-Fi, switching, SD-WAN) and competitive AI features, and its licensing flexibility — including on-premises options — may appeal to organizations with hybrid governance requirements. Northwind University should evaluate total cost of ownership across tiers, desired AI/assurance depth, integration with existing identity and network infrastructure, and long-term vendor roadmap before selecting a solution. All pricing figures in this comparison are estimated and should be validated with vendors or authorized resellers via formal quoting.
